subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

One hard to please (very selective in his habits)
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fastidious.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **"Fastidious" means very selective in one's habits or tastes. **(कठिनता से तृप्त होने वाला)
 
• ** It is used to describe someone who is hard to please or particular about details**.
 
 
• Example: He's very fastidious about the way things are done.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "fastidious" can replace the given set of words.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Dexterous" means skillful and agile. (निपुण)

 
 
• Example: He is a dexterous keyboard player.
 
 
 
• "Incorrigible" means incapable of being corrected or reformed. (असुधार्य)
 
 
• ​Example: He is an incorrigible liar.
 
 
 
• ​"Sadist" means someone who derives pleasure from inflicting pain or suffering on others. (पीड़न कामुक)
 
 
• ​Example: He is revealed to be much more than a mere sadist.
